subject: Next steps: Private hosting ops & on‑prem architecture review — scheduling
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Hernandez <maria.hernandez@edgescale.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-03T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up & scheduling: on‑prem / VPC architecture review

Hi Maria — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next step: you mentioned wanting a focused architecture review with your infra team to validate on‑prem connectivity, encryption/KMS needs, and deployment footprint. The right next meeting for that is our "Private Hosting Architecture Review" (technical deep dive + ops readiness).

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
- 5m: goals & success criteria (EdgeScale)
- 15–20m: infra topology + network / VPC constraints (EdgeScale presents)
- 10–15m: Redwood recommended deployment patterns (on‑prem agent, VPC peering, KV cache behavior)
- 5m: open questions & next steps (procurement, security artifacts)

Suggested slots (PST):
- Tue Feb 10, 10:00–10:45am PST
- Tue Feb 10, 2:00–2:45pm PST
- Wed Feb 11, 9:00–9:45am PST

Please let me know which works or share times for your infra leads (cc Javier or Priya) and I’ll lock the calendar. I’ve attached a short pre‑call checklist and a list of questions that help us tailor the deep dive. If you have any network diagrams or firewall policies we should review ahead of time, please attach those or drop a Drive link.

Attachments: edgescale-privinfra-precall-checklist.pdf; privinfra-precall-questions.docx

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

—
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 415‑555‑0182

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference

From: Maria Hernandez <maria.hernandez@edgescale.co>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Javier Alvarez <javier.alvarez@edgescale.co>, Priya Rao <priya@edgescale.co>
Date: 2028-02-03T11:03:00-06:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & scheduling: on‑prem / VPC architecture review

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear recap and agenda. Javier (CTO) and Priya (infra lead) will join. Of the slots you proposed, Tue Feb 10 10:00am PST works best for our West Coast folks. If you need Priya to present a network diagram she can do that — I’ll ask her to attach the diagram by end of day Fri Feb 7.

Two asks from us before the call:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood typically requests any dedicated VPN endpoints or whether we’ll rely on outbound-only connections?
- We often run a lab VM during deep dives; is a short-lived VM useful for validating connectivity?

If you can confirm the selected slot and share a calendar invite that includes a dial-in and a short pre-read, we’ll accept.

Thanks,
Maria
Head of Platform, EdgeScale

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-03T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up & scheduling: on‑prem / VPC architecture review

Ava — saw Maria’s reply, good to hear Javier and Priya will join. I can make the Feb 10 window but prefer 10:30am PST (I have back-to-back from 9–10). Karthik, any objection to 10:30? If Karthik is tight, we can do 10:00 but I’d prefer 10:30 to keep continuity with other customer calls.

Couple of commercial notes to have ready during the call:
- Basic procurement checklist (we should surface dedicated capacity options vs private deployment SLAs)
- Data residency & KMS requirements — Maria flagged KMS earlier, so have our KMS integrations doc ready (I'll attach in the invite)

Quoted from Maria for visibility:
> Of the slots you proposed, Tue Feb 10 10:00am PST works best for our West Coast folks.

If 10:30 works for everyone, I’ll brief the AE prep points and confirm the renewal/PO cadence expected.

—
Ben Carter

ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 650‑555‑0133

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Hernandez <maria.hernandez@edgescale.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-03T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Confirmed: Private hosting architecture review — Tue Feb 10 10:30am PST

Hi Maria — thanks for confirming. We’ll schedule Tue Feb 10 at 10:30–11:15am PST to give Ben a little padding and to make sure we can handle Q&A. I’ve created a calendar invite (link below) with a short pre-read (the checklist and question doc).

Invite & resources: https://calendar.redwood.ai/invite/ES-2028-0147-priv-review
Pre-read (Drive): https://drive.redwood.ai/privinfra/edgescale/precall

Agenda (final):
- 5m: introductions and goals (EdgeScale)
- 15m: Priya/Javier present current network topology & constraints
- 20m: Karthik presents recommended on‑prem deployment patterns + KMS options
- 10m: open questions, next steps (procurement & timeline)

Notes on Maria’s questions:
- Connectivity: Redwood supports outbound-only connections from customer environment by default; we can discuss optional VPN/peering patterns during the call.
- Lab VM: yes, a short-lived VM is useful if you’d like to validate connectivity during the session — Priya can provide a public egress IP or temporary bastion user and we’ll run quick checks.

Attachments included in the invite: edgescale-privinfra-precall-checklist.pdf, privinfra-precall-questions.docx, redwood-kms-integration-summary.pdf

If anything changes on your side (attendees or time), tell me and I’ll update the invite. See you on Feb 10.

Best,
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 415‑555‑0182
